outcome: Implementation 9da503f passed 259 tests, 26 browser/axe scenarios, 365 Turns and 730 shadow comparisons with 356 disagreements (48.77%), zero shadow failures or stored reasoning and an exact control fingerprint. Tag v4.5.0 at c197f0f is deployed. Production Turn 175 binds the exact revision, records two read-only reference-shadow comparisons, zero DeepSeek usage/cost and zero severe escapes; encrypted pre/post backups and a same-host second-database restore/resumed-write drill pass.
evidence: Primary and shadow use versioned bounded contracts and stable caller IDs
Shadow has a separate monthly budget and no fallback authority
DeepSeek shadow billing contributes to the actual Token/cost ledger

365-Turn shadow and no-shadow world fingerprints are identical
